notes: The same page may serve different listeners. Its Main notes hold the general explanation, while one occurrence in a Presentation can have its own speaker notes. In a lab meeting I might explain the measurement; in this project introduction I use the page to explain evidence preservation. The picture can stay the same while the purpose and spoken explanation change.

designIntent.purpose: Explain how the same page can carry different occurrence notes for different audiences.
designIntent.requestedChange: Use the founder’s account to explain one experience or the design choice it prompted.
keep: Keep the current preview of the same scientific page and the distinction between Main and occurrence notes.
